summary: The product Knowledge API stores concise current records under .fsgg/knowledge with a 10 MiB budget, optimistic expected-revision capture, a writer lock and ordinary Git history. Search reads canonical records; export selects current records and does not include full history, while restore refuses overwrite. Typed workspace initialization seeds a project-knowledge guide and record, guards symlink paths, and adds ignored cache/writer state. This is fsgg.knowledge/1, distinct from organization Atlas fsgg.atlas/1 immutable content-addressed records and SQLite retrieval. The inspected product guidance still names fsgg-sdd knowledge, not Atlas; organization Atlas source delivery must not be reported as already materialized in every existing or newly scaffolded SDD consumer. Preserve the product API and historical records while any consumer guidance/update integration is qualified. The current agent config parser has no knowledgePolicy member and the skeleton AGENTS/CLAUDE text points directly to the product knowledge guide; adding an Atlas policy path alone is not an executable consumer hook.
title: Project knowledge is a separate schema and delivery boundary
